# xshield_enforcement_receipt (Resource)

Reports to Xshield that an enforcement snapshot has been applied, and which AWS resource was created for each key in it. The `aws` enforcement module sends it for you.

Place it in the same configuration as the snapshot's resources and reference their IDs, so it is only sent once they all exist. Xshield rejects a receipt whose hash does not match the snapshot, or whose resources omit or add to the snapshot's, so a partial or altered apply is never recorded as converged.

A new receipt is sent only when the applied version or a resource ID changes, so it adds nothing to a plan that has nothing else to do. If Xshield's latest receipt for the account and region is no longer this one, the next plan proposes sending it again.

Destroying it removes it from state and leaves the receipt history in Xshield.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# The aws enforcement module sends this for you. Written by hand, it must list
# the ID of every resource the snapshot asks for, and reference them, so it is
# sent only once they all exist.
resource "xshield_enforcement_receipt" "this" {
  cloud_account_id = data.xshield_enforcement_snapshot.this.cloud_account_id
  region           = data.xshield_enforcement_snapshot.this.region
  workspace        = "xshield-enforcement-123456789012-us-east-1"
  snapshot_version = data.xshield_enforcement_snapshot.this.version

  security_groups = { for key, group in aws_security_group.this : key => group.id }
  rules = merge(
    { for key, rule in aws_vpc_security_group_ingress_rule.this : key => rule.security_group_rule_id },
    { for key, rule in aws_vpc_security_group_egress_rule.this : key => rule.security_group_rule_id },
  )
  attachments = { for key, attachment in aws_network_interface_sg_attachment.this : key => attachment.id }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `cloud_account_id` (String) Cloud account the snapshot was applied to.
- `region` (String) Region the snapshot was applied to.
- `rules` (Map of String) Security group rule ID created for each key in the snapshot's `ingress_rules` and `egress_rules`.
- `security_groups` (Map of String) Security group ID created for each key in the snapshot's `security_groups`.
- `snapshot_version` (String) Version of the snapshot that was applied, from `xshield_enforcement_snapshot`; Xshield accepts a receipt only for a version it published.
- `workspace` (String) Name of the enforcement workspace that applied it, as shown in Xshield.

### Optional

- `attachments` (Map of String) Attachment ID created for each key in the snapshot's `interface_attachments`.
- `cloud` (String) Cloud the snapshot was applied to. Only `aws` is supported, and it is the default.

### Read-Only

- `applied_at` (String) When Xshield recorded the receipt.
- `id` (String) Receipt identifier assigned by Xshield.
- `run_id` (String) Run that sent the receipt, taken from `TFC_RUN_ID` when running in HCP Terraform or Terraform Enterprise.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import an AWS account's receipt by account and region. This adopts the receipt Xshield currently holds,
# which recovers a lost state file without sending a new receipt.
terraform import xshield_enforcement_receipt.this "123456789012/us-east-1"
```
